notes.content:
We updated a lot in this version, so we set version to 2.0. The main updates are list as follows:
1. We polished the game art, i.e. the trains, villages, buildings, and NPC, etc.
2. Updated engine and now the performance is good.
3. Engine interface, we plan to release our engine.

notes.title: Zion survivors is now available on Steam
notes.content:
You can embark on a journey of zion survivors, discover your purpose and fulfill your destiny
I developed this PC game by myself, and I'm still working on it. Welcome to the steam forum to give me your suggestions and report bugs.
The game script has also been released, and everyone who is interested can modify it (including rules, data and art).
The game is run by a scripting engine. You can run the script directly without compiling it.
Thank you very much.
